description: This file implements a Mac-specific proxy resolver that interacts with CFNetwork to determine proxy settings for URLs, including handling PAC files and synchronizing run loop events.

classes.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver
classes.description: A run loop observer that synchronizes CFNetwork proxy auto-configuration callbacks using a lock to prevent concurrent execution.

classes.name: ProxyResolverMac
classes.description: A Mac-specific proxy resolver that uses CFNetwork to resolve proxies for URLs, including handling PAC files and WebSocket URL adjustments.

methods.name: GetProxyServerScheme
methods.description: Maps CFProxyType strings to ProxyServer::Scheme enums.

methods.name: ResultCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by CFNetwork to deliver proxy configuration results or errors.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::AddToCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Adds the run loop observer to the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RemoveFromCurrentRunLoop
methods.description: Removes the run loop observer from the current run loop in a specified mode.

methods.name: SynchronizedRunLoopObserver::RunLoopObserverCallBack
methods.description: Handles run loop activity events, managing lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: ProxyResolverMac::GetProxyForURL
methods.description: Resolves proxy settings for a given URL by interacting with CFNetwork, handling PAC files, and WebSocket URL adjustments.
